description: The same capture starts queries with different original context ends (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate) Y
%conditions ¬matches($x, driver), begins(from($x), driver)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule driver $y(candidate)
%conditions matches(without-elision($y), rival)
%rule rival X [+T]
%conditions begins(after($), tail)
%rule tail Y
